action.finding: cargo fetch populates local git/registry dependency material for an existing Cargo.lock and subsequent offline Cargo use while that lock remains unchanged; Cargo.lock alone fixes resolution but does not itself populate the cache. --locked prevents lock changes, --offline forbids network and uses only local material, and --frozen combines both.
